sector_rule: u = localX - indexX*5; v = localZ - indexZ*5; a=f32(v-u); b=f32(f32(u+v)-5). a>=0,b>=0 -> lane2; a>=0,b<0 -> lane1; a<0,b>=0 -> lane3; both negative -> lane0.
byte_semantics: All u8 values returned unchanged, including 7; inheritance is handled by consumers.
scope: Complete ground-map lookup and its original coordinate helpers, with reconstructed map records. World/object selection and active global override dispatch are not executed.
limits: Map loader and selection by active room/object context remain unverified.
Map record geometry before the last four bytes is not decoded by this helper.
No complete collision response or movement simulation.
